title: Sign-up email link arrives and signs you in
instructions: On https://elevate-pink-iota.vercel.app/auth/signup, sign up with a real inbox you control (e.g. you+elevate@gmail.com). The email should arrive within a minute and clicking it should land on the disclaimer or onboarding. Afterwards remove the test account from Elevate's admin page.

title: Upgrading through Stripe checkout unlocks the plan
instructions: With a test account, go to Account → Manage plan and upgrade to Plus (Stripe test mode, card 4242 4242 4242 4242). After returning, the plan shows Plus and Export appears under Account → Privacy. Cancel the subscription afterwards.

title: Experiment follow-up reminder email arrives
instructions: With a test account that has email reminders on, finish a retro with an experiment and the shortest follow-up gap. When it's due, the reminder email should arrive and its link should open that experiment's check-in.

title: Clarity gives a sensible real reply
instructions: The automated tests simulate Clarity (no real AI calls). Occasionally, with a Premium/test account, open Clarity from Home and from a retro step, and confirm the replies are sensible, supportive and on-brand.
